steps.en: Prepare the desktop toolchain, launch the app and sign in
steps.zh: 准备桌面工具链，启动应用并登录

steps.en: Place cleared assets, pose the character and frame the stage camera
steps.zh: 摆放有授权的素材，调整人物姿势和场景机位

steps.en: Capture the camera frame and automatically upload the still to the gallery
steps.zh: 按相机画面截图，自动上传静态图到图库

steps.en: Open the image for editing, choose a cloud model and describe the desired shot
steps.zh: 打开图片继续编辑，选云端模型并描述目标镜头

steps.en: Submit the reference and prompt, track the remote job and show its result
steps.zh: 提交参考图和提示词，追踪远程任务并展示结果

component.zh: 原生客户端与云端接口

steps.en: Choose a usable generated image and download it
steps.zh: 挑选可用的生成图片并下载

value.en: A model-generated shot guided by your staged composition, without wiring the scene editor to a provider yourself
value.zh: 用自己摆好的构图引导模型出图，不必自行对接场景编辑器和供应商
